name: bl-annual-business-contribution
description: Saint-Barthelemy annual flat business contribution (contribution forfaitaire annuelle des entreprises, CFAE) for 2026 under the collectivity's Contributions Code as amended on 26 September 2024. Covers who is liable (including dormant enterprises and local establishments), separate activities by NAF/APE code, nonprofit bodies, the 350 euro fixed part and 100 euros per employee, the amended staff certificate, payment from 1 January by 31 March, new businesses within ninety days and none for a start from 1 October, SIRET on transfers, closure, dissolution and changes of legal form. Trigger phrases include CFAE Saint-Barthelemy, contribution forfaitaire annuelle des entreprises, Saint-Barth business tax, St Barts company tax, 350 euros.
